summary: Iteration 13 - Fully tested the NEW supervision schedule feature (backend + frontend). Backend: 7/7 pytest cases pass at /app/backend/tests/test_supervision.py: (1) POST /supervision/import parses /tmp/supervision.pdf and returns imported_days=5, total=47, matched=42, Sunday leader='مازن بن علي القنوبي' with 9 supervisors, Thursday leader='محمد عشري عشري علي'; (2) GET /supervision returns school_name+year_label with each supervisor entry having name+teacher_id; (3) PUT /supervision (replacing all 5 days) adds 'ماجد سلطان الشيذاني' to Tuesday and it persists with teacher_id=null (unmatched); (4) candidates response for Sunday 2026-09-13 exposes 'supervisor' field with at least one free candidate marked 'member'; with &exclude_supervisors=true no candidate has non-null supervisor; (5) GET /day/2026-09-13 returns supervision object with leader/supervisors and assignments carry 'substitute_supervisor'; (6) POST /day/2026-09-13/auto?exclude_supervisors=true returns assignments where every substitute_supervisor is null; (7) DELETE /supervision empties data (total=0) and re-import restores it (imported_days=5). Frontend (Playwright, real preview URL): Login OK -> /substitution/teachers -> sub-teachers-tabs visible, header actions (import/add/delete) visible only on teachers tab and HIDDEN on supervision tab (verified); supervision tab shows sub-sup-title='جدول الإشراف مدرسة الخيرات للبنين ٥-٨ 2026/2027', 5 sub-sup-row-* rows, 6 unmatched (.sub-sup-name.unmatched) names. Edit flow: added 'اسم تجريبي' to الأحد, appeared in Sunday row; removed via sub-sup-remove and after save it's gone. Print button opens /substitution/supervision/print in new tab with sub-sup-print-page + sub-sup-print-title rendered and 5 rows in the table. Distribution page /substitution: date=2026-09-13 (Sunday), زاهر الحبسي selected as absent, AbsentCard sub-day-supervision footer text = ' إشراف الأحد: قائد الإشراف مازن بن علي القنوبي · 9 مشرفاً'. After clicking a .sub-period.has button, 4 sub-cand-supervisor-* badges rendered. Toggling sub-exclude-sup-toggle ON: main list badge count -> 0 AND sub-excluded-supervisors panel becomes visible; toggling OFF returns to 4 badges. localStorage.subExcludeSup='1' persists across page reload. Assigning a supervisor candidate (click sub-assign-<id>) produces a sub-report-supervisor-0 badge in the report table. Cleanup: sub-clear-btn accepted confirm dialog and sub-absent-remove-* worked. Regression: teachers tab still shows 49 rows in sub-teachers-table and the existing sub-import-btn is present. Supervision data is left imported at the end (test_7 re-imports).
critical_code_review_comments: substitution.py is now ~900 lines (was 753). The supervision endpoints add ~90 lines; strongly recommend splitting: substitution/supervision.py (endpoints + parser wiring), substitution/day.py (day/candidates/auto/assign), substitution/export.py (docx). Current file passed the 700-line cap several iterations ago and is now the largest module in the project.

resolve_supervision() in substitution.py rebuilds the full match_teacher() search for every leader+supervisor name on every /day/{d}, /candidates, and /auto call (invoked twice inside enrich_day, once inside rank_candidates via supervisors_of_day). With N=49 teachers and ~47 supervisor names, this is ~2300 O(name-length) matches per candidate ranking. auto_distribute() calls rank_candidates in a loop -> O(slots × 2300). Cache resolve_supervision(doc, tlist) once per request (attach to enrich_day / auto entrypoint) and pass it down.

SubSupervision.jsx uses data-testid values containing raw Arabic day names (sub-sup-row-الأحد, sub-sup-add-input-الأحد, sub-sup-remove-<arabic name>). Works in Playwright but is fragile — any renaming of a supervisor (edit) breaks the testid selector. Consider using stable slugs (day index, teacher id) as testid suffix, with Arabic-only in title/label.

DistributeParts.jsx line 178 reuses data-testid=`sub-assign-${c.id}` inside the excluded-supervisors panel — the SAME testid as the main-list assign button (line 160). If a candidate is present in both lists (shouldn't happen, but defensively), or if both panels render for any reason, Playwright's strict selectors will match two elements. Suggest suffixing the excluded-panel version (e.g. sub-assign-forced-${c.id}).

match_teacher() name normalisation (_key/_tokens) does not strip the Tatweel character (U+0640) or diacritics beyond shadda; unmatched supervisor names should be reviewed to see if any could be matched with better normalisation. 6/47 currently show as unmatched — some may be admin staff (intended) but worth a quick data audit.

Frontend flakiness note: the Playwright automation runs multiple times may leave localStorage.subExcludeSup=1 — reset it or clear localStorage between full E2E runs. The 'sub-day-supervision' footer text has a leading whitespace (from icon + space in JSX) — trim on the receiver side if you need exact-match. 6 supervisor names remain unmatched (amber) in the current dataset — this is expected data (admin/office staff not in teacher list) and is verified in test_2.
